props.description: Period in seconds over which the counter is being incremented.

props.description:
An expression that defines when the rate limit counter should be incremented. It
defaults to the same as the rule's expression.

props.name: mitigation_timeout
props.description:
Period of time in seconds after which the action will be disabled following its
first execution.

props.name: requests_per_period
props.description:

the first time.

props.name: requests_to_origin
props.description: Whether counting is only performed when an origin is reached.

props.name: score_per_period
props.description:
The score threshold per period for which the action will be executed the first
time.

props.description:

increment rate limit counter with.
